rootCauseHypothesis.evidence: Attempt 4 added runway sharp-contact suppression only when player.x >= 350. In portrait, the runway sharp contact anchors at x=301.95, before that threshold. The desktop trace instead stops on white-landing and is not evidence for this runway branch.
rootCauseHypothesis.changeHypothesis: Lower only the Level1 runway sharp-contact suppression threshold to 250 world units; retain the support-specific guard, body/handle bounce path, opening white-landing anchor, and all other contact handling.

acceptanceCriteria: A focused natural-path collision test at the observed early runway x range proves the runway sharp tip/edge no longer anchors while retaining body/handle bounce.
The opening white-landing anchor remains reachable and the existing normal runway replay continues past x=2000.
Independent QA on fresh portrait 390x844 and desktop 1100x720 normal inputs reaches beyond x>1000 and observes the Level1 stack branch; terminal/visible replay is preferred on both viewports.
Full pnpm test, pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck pass and exactly one pnpm build succeeds with a recorded dist/index.html SHA-256.
No fixer self-report or fixture-only trace is treated as natural/perceptual QA evidence.

observed: Portrait attempt 4 first anchors on level1-runway-main at x=301.95 and remains anchored at final x=329.45; desktop final state is anchored on white-landing at x=273.95; terminal and replay are null.
inferred: The x>=350 cutoff lets the portrait contact at x=301.95 anchor; lowering the cutoff to 250 should let the existing body/handle recovery branch keep the player moving.
unknown: Whether the threshold-only change carries ordinary input through the Level1 stack and to settlement/replay on both viewports; independent natural and perceptual QA must determine this.

evidence: Threshold 250 passed the focused x=300 sharp-contact assertion but failed the pre-existing normal forward replay, which terminated at elapsed=4.575s before the expected runway traversal.
Threshold 290 also failed the same forward replay; a follow-up deterministic trace terminated by falling above the course at elapsed=5.392s, x=967.47, before the stack branch.
The implementation and added test were reverted.
experiment.nextHypothesis: Do not skip the runway sharp contact solely by x. Preserve the contact and test a narrow, contact-normal-aware controlled recovery response for the exact early natural tip/edge branch, while retaining the existing anchor behavior for other runway contacts.
